DIAGNOSIS READY: Chondritis of the auricular cartilage.

I see the historical note suggesting tuberculosis, but your current symptoms of shooting ear pain and difficulty wearing earrings after a tympanoplasty point strongly towards cartilage inflammation rather than an infection like TB. I need to confirm if you have any fever, redness, or swelling in the ear, and if the pain is specifically located at the ear canal rim or cartilage.
